description: This file defines the JwtIssuerOptions class, which encapsulates configuration options for JWT token issuance, including claims, issuance times, expiration, and signing credentials.

classes.name: JwtIssuerOptions
classes.description: A class representing configuration options for issuing JWT tokens, including claims details and signing credentials.

methods.name: JtiGenerator
methods.description: A property returning a function that generates a new unique identifier (GUID) for each JWT.

methods.name: Expiration
methods.description: A property returning the expiry DateTime based on 'IssuedAt' plus the 'ValidFor' duration.

methods.name: NotBefore
methods.description: A property returning the current UTC time, representing the 'not before' claim.

methods.name: IssuedAt
methods.description: A property returning the current UTC time, representing the 'issued at' claim.
